meta.title: Register for T-ICR 2026 | Traction Outsourcing
meta.description: Register for the Traction Outsourcing International Corporate Retreat 2026 in Kigali, Rwanda, November 22-30. Only 30 Early Bird seats available.

hero.headline: Register: Kigali Retreat 2026
hero.sub: November 22nd - 30th, 2026 | Kigali, Rwanda | Only 30 Early Bird seats available

paragraphs: Early Bird: ₦3,550,000 / $2,600 per person — limited to the first 30 registrations, ending August 31st, 2026. Standard: ₦5,000,000 / $3,665 per person afterward. Registration closes November 1st, 2026. Fill in the form below and click Proceed to Payment — an invoice with our account details will be emailed to you from t-icr@tolnigeria.com. Full details on inclusions, payment, and policies are on the Registration Information section of the Events page.

sections.heading: Retreat Registration
sections.sub: You will receive an invoice by email with our payment details. Reply to that email with your receipt once paid.
